# block fixtures

- `basic.mmd`: mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample (MIT), copied from
  `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/block.mmd`.
- `intro.mmd`, `widths.mmd`, `shapes-arrows.mmd`: examples from the Mermaid
  block diagram documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/block.html),
  MIT licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `system-cjk.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`, `nested-links.mmd`: written for this
  engine (CJK labels, author styles, nesting, wrapping, link forms).
